sloka: विशस्तकवचं भूमौ व्यपविद्धशरासनम्।हृतोत्तमाङ्गं सौमित्रे त्वामद्य निहतं मया ।। ६.८८.२५ ।।
transliteration: viśastakavacaṁ bhūmau vyapaviddhaśarāsanam।hṛtottamāṅgaṁ saumitre tvāmadya nihataṁ mayā ।। 6.88.25 ।।

translations.english: "Saumithri, he (Rama) will see you struck by me fallen on the ground, shield broken and fallen down, bow thrown down and trunk with severed head."
